bio.text: Merika Coleman, a Democrat, has represented District 19 in the Alabama State Senate since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

According to Ballotpedia, she earned a B.A. in mass communication/media studies in 1995 and an M.P.A. in 1997 from the University of Alabama at Birmingham, and a J.D. from Birmingham School of Law in 2017.
She founded the Law Offices of Merika Coleman.
